_doc: Level-2 orchestrator state for ONE DAG inside a fleet run. Holds a task-DAG (many tasks with internal dependsOn[]), NOT a single-slice progress log. Reports to the captain (status only — technical escalation stops here). Location: <repo>/plans/fleet/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<epic>/dags/<dagId>.json (relative to project repo root, committed there). A DAG can run for hours — persist after every task-step so resume continues mid-DAG. Design ref: docs/design/2026-07-03-pi-parity-orchestration.mdx §4, ~/.pi/agent/docs/design/2026-07-03-fleet-dag-rework.md (§State Schema, Level-2).
_instantiate: Created by the fleet planner alongside state.json (one per DAG), then owned/updated by fleet-orchestrator every task-step + every assumption/escalation. Planner defines a real executable checkCommand per task (layer-1 objective truth-signal); the LAST task in the DAG also carries the DAG-level integration checkCommand. Strip every _doc/_example/_*-prefixed key before writing the instantiated file.
_escalation_boundary: Technical escalation stops at the orchestrator. Only DAG STATUS goes up to the captain. Orchestrator resolves ambiguity itself and records it in assumptions[].

assignment._doc: DAG-level effective assignment (mirrors L1 effective* at dispatch) + upgrade audit trail. Per-task implementer/reviewer live inside tasks[]; this block is the DAG-wide default + safety-ratchet trail.

tasks._dependsOn_doc: Pure task-level dependency (task-DAG internal, cap parallelism at 4 within a DAG). Downstream task blocked until upstream edgeGateStatus is passed.
tasks._reviewer_doc: Only used when the DAG orchestrator is Sonnet (separate fleet-reviewer per task). When the orchestrator is Opus, it doubles as reviewer inline; this field is then advisory only.
tasks._thinking_doc: Per-task reasoning-effort override of the DAG default.
tasks._edgeGateStatus_doc: Downstream task stays blocked until upstream reviewVerdict is pass AND acceptanceResult is pass.
tasks._commitSha_doc: null initially. Partial work is checkpoint-committed to the DAG branch per task -> resume = checkout branch@commitSha + continue.
tasks._artifactPointer_doc: null initially. Pointer to the task artifact (state/commit/output) the judge can reference.
tasks._needsDb_doc: OPTIONAL per-task override of the DAG-level needsDb tag (L1). When set, the captain's readiness probe and this task's checkCommand real-reflection requirement follow the task value, not the DAG default. Absent = inherit DAG tag.
tasks._needsBrowser_doc: OPTIONAL per-task override of the DAG-level needsBrowser tag (L1). When set, the captain's readiness probe and this task's checkCommand real-reflection requirement follow the task value, not the DAG default. Absent = inherit DAG tag.
tasks._checkCommand_doc: Real executable truth-signal command. Planner defines this per task (layer-1 objective validation). The LAST task in the DAG also carries the DAG-level integration checkCommand.
tasks._acceptanceResult_doc: null initially. Recorded ONLY from an actual run of checkCommand by fleet-reviewer (or the Opus orchestrator doubling as reviewer) — never inferred from reading code.
tasks._reviewVerdict_doc: null initially. pass REQUIRES acceptanceResult: pass (green executable), not just code-reading.

assumptions.context: what was ambiguous (spec gap / two valid designs)
assumptions._durable_doc: true -> also pushed to knowledgeDelta[] -> .claude/rules or .claude/skills (durable convention). false -> stays here as judgment audit only.
